                   Public Utility Commission of Texas

                                    Memorandum


 TO:           Interested Persons

 FROM:         Jessie Horn, Sr. Counsel, Rules and Projects Division

 DATE:         November 5, 2026

 RE:           Project No. 58317, SB 6 Implementation



Commission Staff has opened an additional rulemaking project associated with
implementation of Senate Bill 6, as enacted by the Texas 89th Legislature, Regular Session:

   •   Project No. 59999, Rulemaking to Adopt a Standard Large Load Interconnection
       Agreement


The deadline for public comments on the proposal for publication in Project No. 59999 is
December 14, 2026. All public comments on the proposal for publication must be filed in
Project No. 59999.
